description: This file defines a mock API client for the Talenvia platform, providing functions to fetch and update user profiles, skills, mock tests, notifications, applications, and settings. It includes a request helper for HTTP requests and configuration functions for API URLs.

methods.name: normalizeBase
methods.description: Normalizes a URL by removing trailing slash.

methods.name: joinUrl
methods.description: Joins two URL parts into a single URL.

methods.name: getApiConfig
methods.description: Returns API configuration based on environment variables.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request with timeout and error handling.
